arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: LaRue's counsel argued Section 502(a)(2) permits recovery of individual losses.
DeWolff's counsel argued the statute requires plan-level losses.
Chief Justice Roberts questioned the availability of investment choices.
Justice Scalia requested specific code numbers for the provisions.
